review_method: Read-only static inspection and offline byte/hash comparison. No VM probes, services, tests, builds, environment repair or source writes. New changing runtime/probe tools were not reviewed.

findings.conclusion: Existing serde deny_unknown_fields rejects Start.source before handle; the existing unit covers deserialization rejection only. The new bounded live case adds active grant/mount/process identity, runtime-command noninterference, subsequent lawful usability and actual cleanup evidence. It is meaningful without repeating the unchanged 64MiB payload.

Maintained exchange accepts a bounded JSON request dictionary and a complete response object. Its public function permits the deliberate extra field; the ordinary start CLI cannot construct that extra field. Contract requires this maintained exchange rather than a fabricated response.

The explicit unknown-field source error plus ERROR and production_ready=false distinguishes rejection from the existing active-container EBUSY path or an unrelated malformed request. Fresh valid operation ID/workspace and complete before/after actual identity/runtime-command artifact inventory prevent an error-only false PASS.

Exact sentinel bytes through the controller and FUSE view, successful command exit before stop, and actual closure receipts prevent a response-only usability or PID-only closure PASS. No throughput, permissions-completeness or broader POSIX claim is introduced.

Fixed cleanup uses runc kill --all <owned-container> KILL for running/created state, waits for observed stopped state, verifies owned process identity and final clone, detaches the exact clone normally, deletes runtime state and detaches the export. The stop-scope clarification accurately states this existing behavior; it does not replace the contract with graceful application drain or production revocation ACK.

Fixed source/package/runtime identities, one admission check, bounded allocation/free floor, protected old processes/mounts and preservation of first failures remain explicit. This subitem does not reopen G1 historical8/8, close full G2.12/G2.13, qualify production ON, change default OFF, or supersede append/lock/watch FAIL.
